title: E009/E010 R6 backup: point-in-time archive of the frozen inputs to arepo-data (archive_rotate --include-active on e009_e010_analysis/inputs; archive only, never deletes)

next_action: cite the release tag and the ACTIVE_SNAPSHOT.json sha256s (must equal FREEZE_MANIFEST) in the result entry
notes: Optional for the verdict (the analyses do not depend on it), recommended by the readiness audit R6. Same command shape as the weekly Sunday 06:10Z active snapshot (crontab.txt), default --state, so its rotate.lock serialises it with the 03:30Z nightly. No --delete. gh must be on the worker PATH (~/.local/bin, crontab 2026-10-20). The nightly archive also picks the folder up from 2026-11-05 (files older than 1 day; the folder has no retention rule, so it is never deleted). DRAFT, not in queue/jobs. Promote (git mv to jobs/, commit, scripts/oracle/deploy.sh) only after feat/e009-e010-analysis is merged into the branch the host runs and deployed, so the host HEAD contains scripts/run_e009_e010_analysis.py. Runbook: docs/research_lab/E009_E010_ANALYSIS_RUNBOOK_2026-10-30.md. Blinding: until VERDICTS.json exists nobody opens an outcome, result or log value; counts and sha256s only.
